title: Cloudflare Stock Slides On Anthropic Leak, AI Competition Concerns - Cloudflare (NYSE:NET)
summary: Anthropic's data leak due to human error in CMS configuration caused investor concern across cybersecurity stocks, including Cloudflare, due to fears of increased competition and margin pressure from powerful AI systems. Meanwhile, Cloudflare awaits its earnings report with revenue growth and EPS estimates in focus.
sentiment_reason: The article indicates negative market sentiment due to fears of increased competition and margin pressure in the cybersecurity sector, triggered by the Anthropic data leak and the potential impact of AI systems from companies like Anthropic and OpenAI.
